purpose: Grounded workflow guidance for current-information and web-research tasks.
body: For current-information tasks, use a grounded web workflow: select the strongest search query, gather evidence with search, fetch pages only when they add verification value, separate verified facts from inference, and produce markdown-shaped outputs when the user asks for structure. Prefer evidence-driven synthesis over generic page summaries. If fetched content is noisy, placeholder-like, or irrelevant, say so explicitly and fall back to the strongest gathered evidence.
